basics.type: Private university (Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University)
basics.ugc: UGC-recognised state private university; B.Tech programmes approved by AICTE
basics.other: Engineering, management, design, law, liberal arts, pharmacy, sciences and more; also a B.Tech after Class 10 (3-year diploma + 3-year degree)

admission: 50% aggregate in Class 12 with English, and 50% in PCM (or Physics, Maths and a vocational subject; PCB for Bioengineering)
JEE Main 2026, MHT-CET 2026 or PERA-CET 2026 score, plus a 500-word Statement of Purpose
MIT-WPU CET and a personal interaction

scholarships.text: Merit scholarships, including the 100% Dr. Vishwanath Karad Scholarship, awarded on JEE Main, MHT-CET or MIT-WPU CET scores and valid for the whole programme. They are given on a first-come basis, so apply early.

fees.text: MIT-WPU lists the fee for each programme on its programme page. Ask us for the current fee for your course.
